set.body:
Defect: D10, by acknowledgement in the source: 'Two implementations of one rule is one too many, so this one cites the other' (SherlockSceneCoding.scala:14-15) vs gold_scene.py:16. TR=1.5 at SherlockSceneCoding.scala:18 and gold_scene.py:12; alias arithmetic at :21-24 and gold_subject_of.

Do: Collapse to a single declared function over the canonical tables. Whichever side loses, the other calls it or reads its output. Delete the second implementation and the citing comment.

Tests: DIFFERENTIAL test over the current Sherlock gold: old rule and new rule must agree on EVERY row before the old one is removed, and the agreement is recorded as a receipt in the commit body.

Mutants (SD1 — each must die, recorded by name): perturb one alias in the unified rule -> the differential test must fail.

Exit: The rule exists once; the differential receipt is in the commit body.

Plan: docs/plans/2026-09-17-annotation-intake-contract.md S3, P6
